rows.verbatim: stāvoklis, kad ir uztverta un pilnīgi saprasta (kā) būtība, saturs, nozīme; spēja; prasme uztvert un saprast (kā) būtību, saturu, nozīmi;
rows.contextNote: The scheme prints this as the meaning of "Izpratne". The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.

rows.verbatim: cilvēks, ar kuru ir kopā, vienlaikus kādā pasākumā, norisē, apstākļos;
rows.contextNote: The scheme prints this as the meaning of "līdzbiedrs". The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.

rows.verbatim: spēju un īpašību kopums (kādas darbības, uzdevumu veikšanai), mācēšana;
rows.contextNote: The scheme prints this as the meaning of "pratība". The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.

rows.verbatim: darbs, kurā atspoguļota vispusīga, parasti jauna, informācija, kas iegūta, vācot faktus, ziņas, novērojot, eksperimentējot u. tml.; pētīšanas rezultāts.
rows.contextNote: The scheme prints this as the meaning of "pētījums". The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.
The scheme prints this as the meaning of "pelnīt maizi". The examination prints this question in Latvian and it is answered in LATVIAN.

notes: The scheme prices this question '(5 × 1)' and prints no mark against any of its 5 parts, so the card carries the question total and the SEC's gloss for each expression. The paper prints the ask on page 4 of the question booklet.
